events.headline: CONTAINER SHIP SINKS AFTER HITTING MINE IN STRAIT OF HORMUZ (VIDEOS)
events.detail: A container ship sank after hitting a mine in the Strait of Hormuz as the US released footage of an attack on an alleged Iranian spy vessel Read Full Article at RT.com

events.headline: IRAN WAR LIVE: TEHRAN VOWS TO FIGHT UNTIL US YIELDS AS SHIPS SINK IN HORMUZ
events.detail: Iran says it does not seek an endless war, but vows to fight until the US accepts its demands as ships sink in Hormuz.

events.headline: CONTAINER SHIP HIT BY PROJECTILE SINKS IN STRAIT OF HORMUZ, SINGAPORE SAYS
events.detail: All 21 sailors on the Singapore-flagged GFS Pride were evacuated safely after it was hit by an projectile on Tuesday, maritime authorities say.

events.headline: IRAN WILL DESTROY US DATA CENTERS AND AI FACILITIES IF ATTACKED AGAIN – SECURITY
events.detail: Iran’s Mohsen Rezaei warns US data centers, AI facilities and cables in the Gulf could be destroyed if Washington attacks again Read Full Article at RT.com
